questions.q_en:
Match the animals in column A with the phylum they belong to in column B

Column-A Column-B

i. Jelly fish a. Mollusca

ii. Cray fish b. Mammal.

iii. Whale fish c. Insect

iv. Devil fish d. Coelenterate
questions.solution_en:
Jellyfish belongs to the phylum Coelenterate.

Crayfish belongs to the phylum Arthropoda (insect).

Whale belongs to the phylum Chordata (Mammal).

Devil fish (presumably referring to a type of octopus or squid) belongs to the phylum Mollusca.

So, the correct matching is i-d, ii-c, iii-b, iv-a.

questions.q_en: Which of the following is a characteristic of both mammals and birds?
questions.solution_en:
Both mammals and birds are warm-blooded (endothermic), meaning they maintain a constant body temperature regardless of the environment.

· Viviparity (giving birth to live young) is exclusive to mammals.

· Pneumatic bones (hollow bones for flight) are found only in birds.

· Pigmented skin is not a defining characteristic of both groups.

questions.q_en: Which of the following animals has more than one heart?
questions.solution_en: Octopuses have three hearts, which is partly a consequence of having blue blood. Their two peripheral hearts pump blood through the gills, where it picks up oxygen. A central heart then circulates the oxygenated blood to the rest of the body to provide energy for organs and muscles.

questions.q_en: To what phylum does a blood sucking leech belong?
questions.solution_en:
Leeches are segmented worms and belong to the phylum Annelida. Specifically, they are classified under the subclass Hirudinea.

Explanation of Other Options:

• Platyhelminthes: This phylum includes flatworms like planarians, flukes, and tapeworms. They are unsegmented and acoelomate.

• Aschelminthes (Nemathelminthes): This phylum includes roundworms (nematodes). They are pseudocoelomate and unsegmented.

• Cnidaria: This phylum includes animals like jellyfish, corals, sea anemones, and hydras. They are characterized by radial symmetry and stinging cells (cnidocytes).

Further insights:

• Annelids are characterized by their segmented bodies (metamerism). Other members of this phylum include earthworms and polychaetes.

• Most leeches are freshwater inhabitants, while some are found in terrestrial or marine environments.

• Many leeches are blood-sucking (hematophagous) ectoparasites, while others are predators of small invertebrates. Medicinal leeches have been used historically for bloodletting.

questions.q_en: How many chambers are there in the heart of fishes?
questions.solution_en: Fish hearts typically have two chambers: one atrium and one ventricle. This simple cardiovascular system is different from the four-chambered hearts of mammals, reflecting the evolutionary stages of cardiac development.
